title: Structural dynamics in the CENP-A nucleosome impacted by protein-protein interactions with centromere protein N.
authors: Ghosh Moulick, Abhik; Erhardt, Sylvia; Wenzel, Wolfgang; Kozlowska, Mariana
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化MD模拟研究CENP-A核小体与CENP-N蛋白互作对组蛋白结构动态及组蛋白-DNA接触的影响，属广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Noncanonical nucleosomes at the centromere contain the histone variant CENP-A, which plays a crucial role in chromosome segregation. CENP-A is highly regulated, including that by the centromere protein N (CENP-N). Despite its importance, the protein-protein interactions within the CENP-A nucleosome-CENP-N complex remain poorly understood at the molecular level. Here, we employ SIRAH coarse-grained molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate dynamic mechanisms through which CENP-N binding to CENP-A nucleosome modulates structural changes of histones, contributing to the regulation processes. Using a set of mus-long MDs, we reveal enhanced flexibility in the N-terminal region of CENP-A and the stabilization of its RG loop in the complex with CENP-N, thus reshaping the conformational structure of the CENP-A protein. We characterize these allosteric changes and analyze their influence on histone-DNA contacts. Moreover, we demonstrate that they have rather minor effects on the overall stability of the nucleosome and its compactness. A distance-based contact map analysis further elucidates key residues mediating the interaction between CENP-A and CENP-N, while umbrella sampling simulations quantify their binding free energy, which remains challenging to measure experimentally.
abstract_zh: 着丝粒中的非经典核小体含有组蛋白变体CENP-A，其在染色体分离中发挥关键作用。CENP-A受到高度调控，包括通过着丝粒蛋白N（CENP-N）进行的调控。尽管其重要性，CENP-A核小体-CENP-N复合物内的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用在分子水平上仍知之甚少。在此，我们采用SIRAH粗粒化分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟来研究CENP-N与CENP-A核小体结合调节组蛋白结构变化的动态机制，从而参与调控过程。通过一系列mus-long MD模拟，我们揭示了CENP-A N端区域灵活性的增强及其RG环在与CENP-N复合物中的稳定化，从而重塑了CENP-A蛋白的构象结构。我们表征了这些变构变化，并分析了它们对组蛋白-DNA接触的影响。此外，我们证明它们对核小体的整体稳定性及其紧凑性影响较小。基于距离的接触图分析进一步阐明了介导CENP-A与CENP-N相互作用的关键残基，而伞形采样模拟量化了它们的结合自由能，这在实验上测量仍具挑战性。
